description: This file defines API routes for managing FCCH messages in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints to send and peek at FCCH messages, utilizing dependency injection for the FCCH service.

classes.name: FCCHSendRequest
classes.description: A request model extending FCCHMessage, used for sending FCCH messages.

methods.name: dict fcch_send(req: FCCHSendRequest, svc: FCCHService = Depends(get_fcch_service))
methods.description: Endpoint to send an FCCH message; queues the message for transmission.

methods.name: List[FCCHMessage] fcch_peek(limit: int = 10, svc: FCCHService = Depends(get_fcch_service))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve recent FCCH messages stored in memory for debugging.

ctags.pattern: /^class FCCHSendRequest(FCCHMessage):  # reuse fields; message is already serializable$/
